name: research-desk.operator-overview
purpose: Read a safe needs-you count summary or a bounded research-topic overview through the existing owner bindings.
assumptions: Research Desk remains the authority for the selected read; caller identity is preserved by Program Runtime.
invariants: Read-only: invoke exactly one selected Research Desk read binding.
For needs-you, return counts and readability only; never return or store item IDs, titles, bodies, answers, options, links, packet names, secrets, source paths or unreadable details.
For topics, return at most eight slugs and numeric mission/commission counts; omit titles, IDs, paths, write details, warnings, errors, aliases, and workspace data.
Unavailable, partial, and failed owner reads remain explicit in the envelope.

signals.result: For needs-you: item_count, older_list_count, observed_at, unreadable_count, details_redacted and truncation status only. For topics: total count, at most eight topic slugs and numeric commission/mission counts, and a truncation flag.

outputs.evidence: The single Research Desk binding invoked.
